title: Pat
summary: PAT, adjective Fit; convenient; exactly suitable either as to time or place. [Not an elegant word, but admissible in burlesque.] PAT, adverb Fitly; conveniently. PAT, noun A light quick blow or stroke

inlines.v: PAT, adjective Fit; convenient; exactly suitable either as to time or place. [Not an elegant word, but admissible in burlesque.] PAT, adverb Fitly; conveniently. PAT, noun A light quick blow or stroke with the fingers or hand. PAT, verb transitive To strike gently with the fingers or hand; to tap. Gay pats my shoulder and you vanish quite.
